basic_details.job_title: DEO Jangaon External Part-Time Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Six External Part-Time Guest Faculty posts in Mathematics - A & B (2), Physics (1), Chemistry (1), Botany (1) and Zoology (1) are open for IIT-JEE and NEET coaching at Telangana Model School (TGMS), Kodakandla, Jangaon District. The Office of the District Educational Officer, Jangaon District will receive applications from 3 November 2026 to 6 November 2026, either at the Office of the District Educational Officer, Jangaon or at the Office of the Principal, Telangana Model School, Kodakandla. The pay is Rs.650/- per hour for the actual hours of work rendered.

rows.details: Office of the District Educational Officer, Jangaon District
External Part-Time Guest Faculty – Mathematics - A & B, Physics, Chemistry, Botany, Zoology
Rs.650/- per hour for the actual hours of work rendered
Master's Degree (M.Sc.) in the relevant subject and minimum 3 years of IIT-JEE/NEET coaching or foundation course teaching experience
Telangana Model School (TGMS), Kodakandla, Jangaon District
Offline – submission at either of two offices

content_sections.heading: About DEO Jangaon
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Educational Officer, Jangaon District is the district-level education office that issued this notice, signed by Sandeep Kumar Jha, I.A.S, District Educational Officer, Jangaon district. The guest faculty will coach Intermediate First and Second Year students of Telangana Model School (TGMS), Kodakandla, Jangaon District, for IIT-JEE and NEET during the Academic Year 2026-27.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted at either of the following offices: Office of the District Educational Officer, Jangaon, F-27, First Floor, Jangaon. Office of the Principal, Telangana Model School, Kodakandla, Jangaon District. Applications will be received from 3 November 2026 to 6 November 2026. The notice does not prescribe an application form; candidates submit their application along with bio-data and the documents listed under Enclosures. The notice does not mention a postal mode or an email address for applications.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: All six posts carry the same pay: Rs.650/- per hour for the actual hours of work rendered, subject to applicable guidelines and availability of funds. Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in the relevant subject from a recognised University, namely M.Sc. Mathematics, M.Sc. Physics, M.Sc. Chemistry, M.Sc. Botany or M.Sc. Zoology, as applicable. A minimum of three (03) years of teaching experience in IIT-JEE/NEET coaching or foundation courses is mandatory. Sound subject knowledge Good English communication skills Proficiency in ICT-enabled teaching and smart classroom tools Good moral character and medical fitness Preference will be given to: Candidates qualified in JEE/GATE/NET or equivalent examinations Candidates having experience in reputed coaching institutions or Government Residential Excellence Institutions Those having a proven track record of producing successful results in competitive examinations Candidates should check the official notification for the subject-specific eligibility of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many Guest Faculty vacancies are there in DEO Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 6 External Part-Time Guest Faculty posts: Mathematics - A & B (2), Physics (1), Chemistry (1), Botany (1) and Zoology (1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the TGMS Kodakandla Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Applications will be received from 3 November 2026 to 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the Jangaon Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree in the relevant subject from a recognised University – M.Sc. Mathematics, M.Sc. Physics, M.Sc. Chemistry, M.Sc. Botany or M.Sc. Zoology, as applicable.

faq.question: Q4. How much teaching experience is needed?
faq.answer: A minimum of three (03) years of teaching experience in IIT-JEE/NEET coaching or foundation courses is mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Guest Faculty at TGMS Kodakandla?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.650/- per hour for the actual hours of work rendered, subject to applicable guidelines and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for DEO Jangaon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Submit your application with bio-data, copies of educational qualification certificates, experience certificates and other relevant documents at the Office of the District Educational Officer, Jangaon, F-27, First Floor, Jangaon, or at the Office of the Principal, Telangana Model School, Kodakandla, Jangaon District.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Jangaon Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on verification of educational qualifications and teaching experience, subject competency and performance in demonstration classes and interviews, whose date and venue will be communicated to eligible candidates separately.

faq.question: Q8. Is the DEO Jangaon Guest Faculty job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and on a part-time hourly basis for the Academic Year 2026-27 and shall not confer any right to regular appointment.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets preference in the selection?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates qualified in JEE/GATE/NET or equivalent examinations, those with experience in reputed coaching institutions or Government Residential Excellence Institutions, and those with a proven track record of successful results in competitive examinations.
